quarantined_items.summary: A public consultation on EU rules on biobased feedstock in plastic packaging, reference Ares(2026)9620334, is open for feedback from 21 October 2026 to 13 January 2027. The initiative is listed with an active status and a foreseen act type of PROP_REG, covering targets for biobased feedstock and relevant requirements.
reasons: quoted evidence absent from current original source

The source only discusses biobased feedstock, targets for biobased feedstock and relevant requirements; it does not mention recycled-content requirements or documentation obligations.
